name: crossfade
description: Two crossing volume envelopes above a rightward timeline arrow.
useCase: Blend the end of one audio clip into the start of another.
misuse: Give an icon-only control an accessible name for its action.

16.reason: The complete mark and its separate bar or timeline remain clear within the square drawing frame.

24.reason: The full terminals, open spaces and separate control marks retain balanced margins and clear spacing.
